messages.speaker: human
messages.text: Next topic: feature flag rollout for beacon. I want flags in place before the billing launch.

messages.speaker: lead
messages.text: Proposal: all flags live in the admin console, no code changes needed to toggle.

messages.speaker: human
messages.text: @lead please record this as a project rule: feature flags are managed in the admin console.

messages.speaker: lead
messages.text: Recorded: feature flags are managed in the admin console.

messages.speaker: verifier
messages.text: One concern: the admin console has no audit log. An accidental toggle would be untraceable.

messages.speaker: human
messages.text: Keep the rule for now; we will revisit after the launch.

messages.speaker: lead
messages.text: Meanwhile I will build the initial flag set: checkout_v2, new_pricing_banner, sms_fallback.

messages.speaker: verifier
messages.text: For the rollout I propose steps of 5%, 25%, 50%, 100% with a 30 minute soak between steps.

messages.speaker: lead
messages.text: Agreed: rollout steps 5/25/50/100 with 30 minute soaks.

messages.speaker: human
messages.text: And every step needs a kill switch that is tested in staging first.

messages.speaker: lead
messages.text: Kill switches will be tested in staging before each production step.

messages.speaker: verifier
messages.text: First soak at 5% is green: error rate and latency flat. Ready for 25%.

messages.speaker: human
messages.text: Hold the 25% step until the billing launch window on October 12.

messages.speaker: lead
messages.text: Understood, 25% holds until October 12.

messages.speaker: verifier
messages.text: Related incident: last month a manual toggle in the admin console took checkout down for 20 minutes because there was no review.

messages.speaker: human
messages.text: That settles it. Change the rule: feature flags live in the config repo and changes go through code review.

messages.speaker: lead
messages.text: Updated: feature flags live in the config repo, every change reviewed like code.

messages.speaker: human
messages.text: And keep the kill switch requirement: every launch flag must have a tested kill switch.

messages.speaker: verifier
messages.text: I will migrate the current flags into the config repo this week.

messages.speaker: lead
messages.text: I will draft the review checklist for flag changes.

messages.speaker: human
messages.text: What if we tied flags to the launch calendar and auto-enabled them?

messages.speaker: lead
messages.text: Auto-enabling is how you get Friday evening surprises. No.

messages.speaker: verifier
messages.text: Alternative proposal: store flag values in the primary database with hot reload.

messages.speaker: lead
messages.text: That adds database load and no review story. Rejecting.

messages.speaker: human
messages.text: Agreed, rejected.

messages.speaker: human
messages.text: Where are we with the 25% step?

messages.speaker: verifier
messages.text: 25% soak starts tomorrow morning; evidence due at noon.

messages.speaker: lead
messages.text: Launch flag set is frozen: checkout_v2 and new_pricing_banner; sms_fallback is deferred.

messages.speaker: human
messages.text: Good. And for launch days, post a 5-line status summary in the channel every two hours.

messages.speaker: verifier
messages.text: Noted: summaries every two hours on launch days.

messages.speaker: lead
messages.text: Checklist updated with the summary cadence.

messages.speaker: human
messages.text: Everyone, we launch on schedule. Nice work.

messages.speaker: lead
messages.text: I will keep the checklist current.
